t: Found living in nether brick nests in nether fortresses. Magmatic Bees prefer pollinating magma blocks or nether wart.$(br)Be careful of what material you build their enclosure with, these buggers can turn cobblestone into lava.
栖息在下界要塞中的地狱砖块蜂巢里。熔岩蜜蜂更喜欢为岩浆块或下界疣授粉。$(br)建造它们围栏时一定要注意材料，这些家伙会把圆石变成岩浆。
